title: Efficacy of selective laser trabeculoplasty for normal tension glaucoma: 1 year results

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0)

indication: normal tension glaucoma on topical medication, no prior glaucoma surgery or laser; ethnic Chinese; prospective cohort, right eyes analysed

groups.description: single 360-degree selective laser trabeculoplasty session after a 1-month medication washout; medications resumed from 1 month to reach a 30% target reduction

extraction_decision: no admissible series; no record built

exclusions.what: Table 1 R2 mean IOP series (C3 'Base-line' post-washout reference, C4-C10: 1 day, 1 week, 1, 3, 6, 9, 12 months)
exclusions.reason: outcome-selected analysis set (protocol inclusion 4): Methods exclude eyes in which a repeated SLT or any intraocular surgery was performed within 12 months of the first SLT, and the study defines the need for repeat SLT as procedure failure; the 41 analysed eyes are therefore only eyes free of an additional glaucoma procedure throughout follow-up (Results: two eyes removed for a second SLT, two for phacoemulsification, one deceased)
same outcome-selected analysis set; alternative (medicated) reference of the same eyes

exclusions.what: Table 1 R3 (number of anti-glaucoma eye drops)
absolute/qualified success proportions and Kaplan-Meier repeat-SLT survival (Results, Fig. 3)
exclusions.reason: success proportions and Kaplan-Meier estimates are not admissible

notes: Had the analysis set been admissible: tonometry Goldmann applanation; the study tabulates both a medicated pre-study IOP and an unmedicated post-washout baseline (mean of 9 am, 1 pm and 5 pm phasing), and medications were resumed after the 1-month visit.
Exclusion of eyes not completing 12 months is ordinary attrition, but the repeat-SLT exclusion is defined by a postoperative outcome, which makes every tabulated mean outcome-selected.
